chains.name: Kernel failure class erased at the FFI, the actor thread and the eval diagnostic
chains.description: C++ distinguishes Standard_Failure, ContractViolation, std::exception and unknown; wrap_occt_call rethrows all as runtime_error(String) with an FFI function-name prefix; Rust re-wraps at 131 hand-written map_err sites into the single GeometryError::OperationFailed(String) (verified). Downstream: reify-ir has no corrupt-handle or contract-violation variant, so the crate encodes class in message prefixes and '[rust-guard]' markers that tests pin by English substring; the actor thread has no catch_unwind and reports every death as the literal 'kernel thread died' at 35 sites (verified); reify-eval's TopologyCorrespondenceDropTally renders user Info text from C++ counter names ('silent_drop_count', verified engine_build.rs ~1377) because the typed history carries raw u32 counters. #5895/#5898 (FFI symbols leak into user diagnostics), #7385 (no crash boundary), #5211/#7379 sweeps and the nine copied IsNull guards are this chain. S14 κ's BackendUnavailable was cancelled (S10 R5) because it had no producer; these variants do.
chains.proposal: One typed fault at the bridge and typed variants in reify-ir. `FfiFault { kind: Contract|Native|Internal, op, detail }` encoded once in C++ and decoded once in `From<cxx::Exception>`; GeometryError gains CorruptHandle(id), ContractViolation{detail}, KernelFailure{op,detail} (landing in S10 α2's geometry/error.rs) so the 131 map_err sites become `?` and the diagnostic layer renders from the variant. The actor handle gets an `ActorState { Running | Panicked{payload} | Shutdown }` cell with catch_unwind per request, replied as KernelFailure, so 'kernel thread died' becomes one function with the cause. A single C++ `live_topology(&OcctShape)` accessor replaces the copied IsNull guards. S11 δ's typed history carries a `CorrespondenceLoss` enum so the eval tally stops rendering counter names.
chains.routing: amend S10 (α2 #8931 adds the variants in error.rs; the typed-reply leaf consumes them) + amend S11 (θ #8672's D7 stops freezing 'kernel thread died'; ε #8682's ShapeStore::get returns CorruptHandle; δ #8676's history gains the loss enum). fk-11b120086a30's C++ accessor is uncovered by any leaf and rides with ε. Why: both streams are already editing these exact boundaries; the only missing decision is that the error type is structured, which must be ruled before θ/ε freeze the String mapping into new modules.

chains.name: Admission policy decided per GUI door instead of in the engine API
chains.description: EngineSession::update_source ignores its path argument whenever a file is loaded (verified), so 'only the active entry may be overwritten' is a guard that exists on one of four doors (debug_server only, #5097) and the Tauri editor, watcher and TauriToolContext doors reach the same call unguarded; the watcher target is re-armed by two of three open funnels (verified main.rs:484/1041 only), so a debug-driven open leaves a stale watcher whose next event replaces the new design through that same path-ignoring call; preview liveness has no state variable, so commit_parameter recompiles on every refusal and the six #5099 fixes patched consequences; path-write policy is stated four times with the screenshot save_path escaping #7816's confinement; the sidecar 'must be Ready' table is copied per command. The gates that stopped regressing (export's RepresentationWithin refusal, #6190; commit_parameter's ledger) are exactly the ones moved inside EngineSession. S25 unifies ordering and publication (QueuedEngine, one tool implementation over the host trait) but re-implements admission in the AI host only (xi row 3/6).
chains.proposal: Admission as engine-API types, uniformly enforced at one choke point as export already is. `EntryDocument` from `EngineSession::resolve_target(path) -> Result<_, NotActiveEntry>` as update_source's parameter (the String disappears); `persistable_source() -> Result<&str, RejectedBuffer>`; a `PreviewState { None | Live{cell, generation} }` field cleared only through commit_state and read by export/save/state publication; `WriteTarget::admit(origin: User|Assistant, requested, design)` as the only path type save/export/image tools accept; a `DesignWatch::reconcile(engine_path)` driven from S25 λ's SessionEvents 'design_loaded' so every funnel re-arms by construction; `SidecarState::require_ready()` inside the handle methods.
chains.routing: amend S25 (ξ #8950 moves admission into EngineSession rather than the host; ο #8951 deletes the debug-server copies; λ #8947's sink carries design_loaded; ρ #8954's open funnel calls reconcile; η #8943's builder reads PreviewState). fk-2513539f4913 folds into S26 α #9062. Why: S25's strengthened ruling (one tool implementation over the host trait) closes the MCP-tool doors but not the Tauri editor and watcher doors, which are not MCP tools; placing admission in the engine closes all doors under the ruling's own 'no logic twice' principle.

chains.name: Form-find input validation, gauge and spectrum re-derived per entry point (and per decoder)
chains.description: The reify-eval trampoline (tensegrity_crack) fully range-checks member/anchor/surface indices before the kernel is called, and the kernel re-checks them per entry (#7553 ×4, #6563 ×3 added the same guard at successive entries) with a DimensionMismatch variant that lies about its cause; the stdlib viewport accessors decode the same Tensegrity topology a second time with silent-Undef semantics (.8). Finiteness is checked nowhere (`s <= 0.0` accepts NaN; `0 < 0` lets a zero warp_dir through to a NaN frame misreported as SingularReducedStiffness, .5), the GroupRatios spec guard is copied verbatim into two search functions (.2), the gauge normaliser exists six times with absolute floors (.3; #6119/#6413/#6983/#7046/#7801 are the same invariant fixed five times), the combined free-standing path never asserts nullity == 4 (.1), and dense spectrum classification plus its panicking .expect exists three times across two modules (.6). #8628 (S14's ForceDensityProblem) validates anchored and Explicit shapes only.
chains.proposal: Extend #8628's validated problem to be the single boundary: `ForceDensityProblem::free(nodes, members, kinds, FreeSpec)` with `GroupSpec::new` as the only group-check home, finiteness in `MemberKind::admits` and `AnisotropicSurfaceStress::new`, `IndexOutOfRange{what,index,len}` and `NonFinite{what,index}` replacing DimensionMismatch; a `TensegrityTopology::from_value` shared by stdlib accessors and the trampoline; a crate-private `StiffnessScale` (fd_criteria.rs) computed once per assembled D with `relative_equilibrium_residual(rows)` returning INFINITY on zero/NaN rows for both anchored and free paths; `FreeStandingForm::certify` called by validate_explicit and the tail of form_find_free_surfaces; a `spectrum` module below form_find/form_find_free/prestress_stability owning assemble_d and `SymmetricSpectrum::of -> Result`. The 311-line free loop splits along the QSource/StallGuard axes after these land.
chains.routing: amend S14 (#8628 widened to FreeSpec, finiteness, typed index errors and BT cases; the StiffnessScale and spectrum modules as two new S14 leaves below #8628; #7801/#7571/#7613 re-pointed onto them) + S15/S16 note for TensegrityTopology's home. Why: S14's ruling already names 'validated force-density problem, one sign-rule home'; these are the parts of that problem the PRD left outside the boundary.

chains.name: Per-new-file registries across the verify tree, layout guards and scope lists
chains.description: The same shape at every layer of the verify tree: a fact about a file or crate is declared in a central list away from the file, kept in sync by a hand-maintained drift test, and forgotten on the next addition. Cargo's auto-discovery of tests/*.rs plus bare-mod resolution forces a mandatory #[path] on 846 member declarations and a 3,308-line bash guard with an awk mod-graph parser that gives wrong answers on four shapes (verified: no tests/*/main.rs, no autotests/[[test]]); the harness baseline and the empty _KLOC_WARN_KNOWN ratchet; the 203-row run-all classification manifest (94% 'pool', 71 edits); the 174-row verify-pipeline-infra-tests.txt artifact→guard map; crate scope classes in a Python frozenset, two txt files, a yaml copy and a bash literal; three bash copies of reify-audit's sweep predicates; a four-variable git-env scrub beside the eight-variable canonical list. The mined themes 'test placement churn' (~70 commits), 'register X in Y' (~30) and the harness kLOC splits are this chain's cost; the fix history is almost entirely pre-merge registration repair, not defects. S18 derives some sets (kloc, fixtures, gate paths) and keeps others as lists; S19 keeps 'row in the same diff' (D8) and plans to entrench the WARN ratchet as a manifest (D11).
chains.proposal: Declare at the source and derive every list. Harness layout: tests/harness_x/main.rs (cargo auto-discovers the same binary name; bare `mod` resolves correctly, so the #[path] mandate and the awk parser die), directory-driven membership, `autotests = false` with [[test]] entries so the baseline manifest becomes Cargo's own validated list; the hard kLOC cap stays, measured on dep-info non-comment lines, the WARN ratchet becomes advisory output. Infra tests: a required `# run-all-bucket:` pragma and a `# guards:` header read by one parser in reify_verify.selection (S19's classification_discovered_set reads the pragma), the manifest and the artifact map becoming generated snapshots or deleted. Crates: `[package.metadata.reify-scope]` read by reify_path_attribution.py from the cargo metadata call affected_crates already makes. verify.sh: one frozen ChangedSet gathered once with one fail-wide policy carried on ScopeDecision, selectors as a SelectorRule table; reify-audit's sweep predicates as one data file include_str!'d by Rust and read as a DataFile by Python. lib_main_checkout calls reify_git_env_scrub.
chains.routing: new stream (cargo-native harness layout: fk-e2a244cfb575/.2/.4/.7 — a cross-crate layout move outside S19's 'guard engines to sourced libs' scope, and it rescopes #8700 θ to the residual kLOC measure) + amend S19 (D8 and classification_discovered_set read the pragma; D11 dropped) + amend S18 (#9097: ChangedSet/SelectorRule, fail-wide staged diff reversing D5, scope-class metadata; #9100: guards header; the reify-audit predicate file as the follow-up S18 §9 names). fk-b9c181bf0723 is uncovered by S18/S20 (verified: S20's PRD names neither lib) and is a small standalone task. Why: the harness-layout move needs its own owner and sequencing against the consolidation program; the rest are amendments to leaves not yet started.
